name: WdChevronConvertRule
description: Specifies rules for converting text enclosed in chevron characters (< >) to merge fields.

constants.name: wdNeverConvert
constants.description: The converter passes the text through without attempting any interpretation.

constants.name: wdAlwaysConvert
constants.description: The converter attempts to convert text enclosed in chevrons (< >) to mail merge fields.

constants.name: wdAskToNotConvert
constants.description: The converter prompts the user to convert or not convert chevrons when a Word for the Macintosh document is opened.

constants.name: wdAskToConvert
constants.description: The converter prompts the user to convert or not convert chevrons when a Word for the Macintosh document is opened.
